issue_context.title: Aqara Magic Cube in Deconz integration rotation cannot be separated from other events
issue_context.body:

**Home Assistant release with the issue:**

0.101.2
<!--
- Frontend -> Developer tools -> Info
- Or use this command: hass --version
-->


**Last working Home Assistant release (if known):**
Probably never worked

**Operating environment (Hass.io/Docker/Windows/etc.):**
<!--
Please provide details about your environment.
-->
hassio under Ubuntu.
Deconz is latest beta 2.05.70 


**Integration:**
<!--
Please add the link to the documentation at https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/ of the integration in question.
-->
Deconz

**Description of problem:**

I just installed an Aqara (Mi) Magic Cube which is a switch/sensor supported by Deconz. I can see in Deconz the events being generated when I turn and tilt and move the cube.
And when I rotate the cube I see the angle of the motion reported also.
And you can see in the Phoscon app what is move/turn/share etc and what is rotation

In Home Assistant the deconz_event is merged into a single event number. And this is a problem because you cannot see if 1002 is a turn from face 2 to face 1 or it is a rotation clockwise that happen to be the value 1002. There is nothing in the entire event contant that indicates what type of event it is and the result is that you cannot use the Cube for anything via Deconz

I have raised a similar report on deconz github because it is not clear where the issue is or where it should be solved. 

Ref https://github.com/dresden-elektronik/deconz-rest-plugin/issues/2037

**Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml` entries and (fill out even if it seems unimportant):**
```yaml

```

**Traceback (if applicable):**
```

```

**Additional information:**
comments: Hey there @kane610, mind taking a look at this issue as its been labeled with a integration (`deconz`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L73) for? Thanks!

I have some additional info.

I have noticed something new.

I deleted my Magic Cube and cleaned manually the core.device_registry and core.entity_registry.

And then restarted HA and re-paired the cube in Phoscon

It then gets recorded as switch_81 and switch_82. switch_81 is the name for the battery sensor also.

Then I restart Home Assistant and the switch_82 autorenames (I did nothing in Phoscon) to Mi Magic Cube (the default name that Phoscon assignes). The battery sensor stays as switch_81 in HA.

Now turning the cube is switch_82. And rotation are events from mi_magic_cube.

Then I rename the device in Phoscon and all events become the new name and you cannot separate the events again. The problem is that the Cube gets registered as two different switches by default but the minute you rename the cube to something else in Phoscon else merge to one. 
Note that the problem with same name happens after a new restart of HA. HA sync the device name from Deconz only when you restart HA
If the event names had a suffix auto appended it would work and you could seperate the two types of events

To those needing a work around while this item remains open.

See this forum post. It makes the cube possible to use with current code

https://community.home-assistant.io/t/mi-magic-cube/136701/24

Not elegant but it works

This is the first device with multiple endpoints doing deconz_events, I didn't know this existed.

I don't have enough data to know what would be any change needed. From what I can see both events would be repeated in hass and there is a big difference in what values they get.

I can understand your surprise. It is unusal. See the other github bug that I raised. The Deconz guys have given some thoughts.

The deconz api returns a unique ID which is not the same for the two devices

They JSON pairs are "uniqueid":"00:15:8d:00:02:b9:33:a9-03-000c" vs "uniqueid":"00:15:8d:00:02:b9:33:a9-02-0012"

But in the HA event I only see "unique_id": "00:15:8d:00:02:b9:33:a9"

If these unique IDs were reported in full that could also be used to separate the two types from each other.

In the deconz API there is also a "gesture" number that has an integer value depending on the last motion and they are also all unique for flip 90, flip 180, move, shake, rotate CW, and rotate CCW. If this gesture value was in the event data that could be used to separate the events. 

There are several ways we could do it. Both unique ID and gesture would not be a breaking change for most because you normally create automations based on the event number.

Hi. I have recorded the exact JSON that comes from the Websocket from Deconz for all possible types of Gestures

The possible things in the JSON that could be used to know what is rotation and what is other gestures are..

'id' is different. (the sequence number) but I would hate to use that in automations because if I have to re-pair the cube these will increase and I can change all automations again.

'uniqueid' is different. Deconz appends to the uniqueid like 00:15:8d:00:02:b9:33:a9-03-000c vs 00:15:8d:00:02:b9:33:a9-02-0012. I think these do not change at re-pairing. In HA we only see 00:15:8d:00:02:b9:33:a9

My favorite would be if the state{gesture} JSON value would be added along with buttonevent and lastupdated.

It would actually not only solve the problem with what is rotation and what is other gesture. It would simplify making automations where you just want to detect a 180 deg flip or you want to write an automation for all 90 deg flips with actions that depend on the face (buttonevent first digit).

Having the 'gesture' value would be the cool solution.

And I do not see it as a breaking change because it is not there now. And it would not affect already existing automations that just look for the event 4 digit number as it would not change.

Naturally it needs to be possible to use this value in simple automations.

I imagine

```
  trigger:
    platform: event
    event_type: deconz_event
    event_data:
      id: magic_cube_gestures
      gesture: 3
  condition:
    condition: template
    value_template: >
      {% set valid_events = [4001, 4002, 4003, 4005, 4006] %}
      {{ trigger.event.data.event in valid_events }}
   ...
```

OK so here is the complete list of actual examples of all possible gestures with a note and the actual data from the websocket

```
Wake up (first message sent when cube has been untouched for a while)
{"e":"changed","id":"84","r":"sensors","state":{"buttonevent":7000,"gesture":0,"lastupdated":"2019-11-07T08:59:55"},"t":"event","uniqueid":"00:15:8d:00:02:b9:33:a9-02-0012"}

Shake
{"e":"changed","id":"84","r":"sensors","state":{"buttonevent":7007,"gesture":1,"lastupdated":"2019-11-07T08:40:46"},"t":"event","uniqueid":"00:15:8d:00:02:b9:33:a9-02-0012"}

Drop (fall - drop from one hand to the other)
{"e":"changed","id":"84","r":"sensors","state":{"buttonevent":7008,"gesture":2,"lastupdated":"2019-11-07T08:48:43"},"t":"event","uniqueid":"00:15:8d:00:02:b9:33:a9-02-0012"}

Flip 90 deg (event is 4 digit - Y00X where Y is new face and X is previous face)
{"e":"changed","id":"84","r":"sensors","state":{"buttonevent":2006,"gesture":3,"lastupdated":"2019-11-07T08:46:18"},"t":"event","uniqueid":"00:15:8d:00:02:b9:33:a9-02-0012"}

Flip 180 deg (event is 4 digit - Y00X where Y is new face and X is previous face)
{"e":"changed","id":"84","r":"sensors","state":{"buttonevent":5002,"gesture":4,"lastupdated":"2019-11-07T08:46:45"},"t":"event","uniqueid":"00:15:8d:00:02:b9:33:a9-02-0012"}

Push (move cube without tilting)
{"e":"changed","id":"84","r":"sensors","state":{"buttonevent":6000,"gesture":5,"lastupdated":"2019-11-07T08:41:50"},"t":"event","uniqueid":"00:15:8d:00:02:b9:33:a9-02-0012"}

Double tap (same face - event is 4 digit X00X where X is the face up)
{"e":"changed","id":"84","r":"sensors","state":{"buttonevent":2002,"gesture":6,"lastupdated":"2019-11-07T08:51:02"},"t":"event","uniqueid":"00:15:8d:00:02:b9:33:a9-02-0012"}

Rotate CW (any face up, event is positive up to 5 digit numbers, note that unique ID and id are different for rotation)
{"e":"changed","id":"83","r":"sensors","state":{"buttonevent":2841,"gesture":7,"lastupdated":"2019-11-07T08:43:05"},"t":"event","uniqueid":"00:15:8d:00:02:b9:33:a9-03-000c"}

Rotate CCW (any face up, event is negative integer up to 5 digit numbers, , note that unique ID and id are different for rotation))
{"e":"changed","id":"83","r":"sensors","state":{"buttonevent":-3612,"gesture":8,"lastupdated":"2019-11-07T08:43:39"},"t":"event","uniqueid":"00:15:8d:00:02:b9:33:a9-03-000c"}
```

One thing I do not understand is where does HA stores the Names of the two devices. Are they loaded to HA at boot and kept in memory? The work around I use now is that I rename the two Cube device using the Deconz Rest API. This gets overwritten if I rename the device again in Phoscon but as long as I don't touch the name in Phoscon these Rest API name changes seem to stick

I am not sure you have the same problem but i had som trouble while paring my cube in deconz. It acted as two units in HA. Hade to re-pair it multiple times before it worked. My cube is working with all commands. I don't have the aqara cube, i have the mi cube.
Running HA 0.99.3 at the moment.
